onboarding.subtitle: To get started, choose a transcription model

parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: English only. The best model for English speakers.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Very fast, English only. Handles accents well.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: Fast, English only. Good balance of speed and accuracy.

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: Optimized for Taiwanese Mandarin. Code-switching support.

sense-voice-int8.name: SenseVoice
sense-voice-int8.description: Very fast. Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese.

gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.name: GigaAM v3
gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.description: Russian speech recognition. Fast and accurate.

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash
canary-180m-flash.description: Very fast. English, German, Spanish, French. Supports translation.

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: Accurate multilingual. 25 European languages. Supports translation.

cohere-int8.name: Cohere
cohere-int8.description: A large, slower, but very accurate multilingual model.

permissions.title: Permissions Required
permissions.description: crwbar voice needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

microphone.title: Microphone Access
microphone.description: Required to hear your voice for transcription.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Access
accessibility.description: Required to type transcribed text into your applications.

errors.checkFailed: Failed to check permissions. Please try again.
errors.requestFailed: Failed to request permission. Please try again.

capabilities.streaming: Shows live transcription as you speak

dragDrop.label: Transcribe Dropped Files
dragDrop.description: Drop an audio file on the recording bar or this window to transcribe it.

autoCopy.label: Copy to Clipboard Automatically
autoCopy.description: Every transcript also lands on the clipboard.

shortcut.title: crwbar voice Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts to trigger speech-to-text recording

transcribe.name: Transcribe Shortcut
transcribe.description: Starts dictation anywhere on your Mac.

cancel.name: Cancel Shortcut
cancel.description: The keyboard shortcut to cancel the current recording.

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Post-Processing Hotkey
transcribe_with_post_process.description: Optional: always runs AI post-processing on the result.

voice_action.name: Voice Action Shortcut
voice_action.description: Speak an instruction; your AI backend writes the text.

copy_last_transcript.name: Copy Last Transcript
copy_last_transcript.description: Copies the most recent transcript to the clipboard.

insert_last_transcript.name: Insert Last Transcript
insert_last_transcript.description: Pastes the most recent transcript where you type; the clipboard stays as it was.

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value

language.title: Language
language.description: Auto detects the language; picking one can be more accurate.

pushToTalk.label: Push To Talk
pushToTalk.description: Hold to record, release to stop

recordingBuffer.title: Keep Recording After Release
recordingBuffer.description: Catches the last word if you let go a moment early. Transcription starts that much later.

models.title: Transcription Models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

rescan.label: Rescan
rescan.tooltip: Rescan for models added to the models folder or Hugging Face cache outside crwbar voice

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

duckingSpeed.title: Ducking Speed
duckingSpeed.description: How fast other sound fades down and back up.

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep Mic Open Between Transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone open for 30 s after recording, so the next one starts faster. Can lower Bluetooth audio quality.

transcribe.title: transcribe.cpp Acceleration
transcribe.description: Hardware for Whisper-family models. Auto uses the GPU when there is one (Metal on macOS).

ort.title: ONNX Acceleration
ort.description: Hardware for ONNX models (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine). DirectML on Windows is experimental and may fail.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start crwbar voice when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the crwbar voice icon in the system tray.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: None hides it, Minimal shows a small pill, Live shows the text as you speak (streaming models only).

position.title: Overlay Position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: How the text gets into the app you are typing in. None only updates history and clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Linux tool for the Direct paste method; Auto picks the best one.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Presses the chosen keys after the text is in, e.g. Enter to send a message.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Translates speech in other languages to English.

modelUnload.title: Unload Model
modelUnload.description: Frees memory when the model has not been used for this long.

customWords.title: Custom Words
customWords.description: Words that often come out wrong; similar-sounding words are corrected to match.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice Activity Detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Leaves out silence. Off records the raw audio.

voiceAction.title: Voice Actions
voiceAction.privacy: Your spoken instruction and any enabled context are sent to the selected AI service. Clipboard context is off by default.

backend.title: AI Backend
backend.description: Use the configured API provider or an installed, signed-in Codex or Claude CLI.

clipboardContext.label: Include Clipboard Context
clipboardContext.description: Sends the clipboard text along, for commands like ‘Write an email from this’.

context.title: Persistent Context
context.description: Sent with every Voice Action: your role, company, tone, words to avoid. Never used for normal transcriptions.
context.placeholder: Example: I work at … Keep emails concise, friendly, and direct.
context.storage: Saved as you type, stored locally on this device, and only sent with Voice Actions — never with normal transcriptions.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Selected Prompt
selectedPrompt.description: Select a template for refining transcriptions or create a new one. Use ${output} inside the prompt text to reference the captured transcript.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click 'Create New Prompt' above to create your first post-processing prompt.

history.empty: No transcriptions yet. Start recording to build your history!
history.deleteError: Failed to delete entry. Please try again.
history.retranscribeError: Failed to re-transcribe. Please try again.
history.transcriptionFailed: Transcription failed. You can re-transcribe using the retry icon.
history.partialHint: This run stopped before the end of the audio. The text covers only part of the recording.

noAudio.title: Audio not available
noAudio.stopped: Stopped early — only the text up to that point was kept.
noAudio.removed: Removed to save space — older recordings keep only their text.

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

liveLogs.title: Live Logs
liveLogs.description: Stream application logs in real time to diagnose issues without opening the log file. Only logs emitted while this panel is open are shown; respects the Log Level setting above.
liveLogs.empty: Waiting for logs… Entries appear here as the app emits them.

whatsNewPreview.title: Preview What's New
whatsNewPreview.description: Open the latest bundled release note without marking it as seen

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: Recordings With Audio
historyLimit.description: How many of the newest recordings keep their audio. Transcripts always stay.

recordingRetention.title: Auto-Delete Recordings
recordingRetention.description: Delete the audio of older recordings to save space. Transcripts are always kept.

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Always-On Microphone
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: AI Features
postProcessingToggle.description: Post-processing and Voice Actions. Nothing is sent to an AI service while this is off.

muteWhileRecording.label: Lower Audio While Recording
muteWhileRecording.description: Fade system audio down while recording, then restore it

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard Implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay (Before)
pasteDelay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after copying text, before sending the paste keystroke. Increase if nothing gets pasted.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Paste Delay (After)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after the paste keystroke, before restoring your previous clipboard. Increase if your old clipboard content is being pasted instead of the transcription.

accent.title: Accent Color
accent.description: For buttons, the recording bar and highlights. Reset returns to orange.

rgbMode.label: Emil Mode
rgbMode.description: Cycles the accent through the rainbow while it is on.

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where crwbar voice stores its data

sourceCode.title: Handy
sourceCode.description: crwbar voice is a refinement of the complete Handy codebase by CJ Pais—not an independent rewrite. This fork adds its own fixes, workflow changes, and visual direction.

supportDevelopment.title: Support Development
supportDevelopment.description: Help us continue building crwbar voice

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: High-performance tensor library for on-device machine learning inference
ggml.details: crwbar voice's local speech-to-text is built on transcribe.cpp and ggml. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. To update: download the latest NSIS installer from GitHub Releases, install it to the same folder, then copy your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) from the old version to the new one.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: crwbar voice needs accessibility permissions to type transcribed text.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Microphone access was denied by the operating system. Please grant microphone permission in your system settings.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Enable microphone access in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone (including desktop app access).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Grant microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Grant microphone access in your system's sound or privacy settings.

errors.noInputDevice: No audio input device was detected. Please connect a microphone or headset and try again.
errors.pasteFailed: Text could not be pasted into the active application.

appLanguage.title: Application Language
appLanguage.description: Change the language of the crwbar voice interface

theme.title: Application Theme
theme.description: Choose whether crwbar voice follows your system theme or stays light or dark

overlay.dropHint: Drop an audio file here to transcribe it

transcribe.title: Transcribe a file
transcribe.heading: Transcribe an audio file
transcribe.body: Pick a recording and it is transcribed here, in the app. Nothing is typed into other windows and nothing appears on the recording bar — useful for meetings and long voice notes.
transcribe.formats: WAV, MP3, M4A, AAC, FLAC, OGG, OPUS and CAF — WhatsApp voice notes and Apple Voice Memos included.
transcribe.workingHint: Long recordings are transcribed in pieces, so an hour of audio can take a few minutes.
transcribe.savedToHistory: Saved to History, where it is tagged as a file transcription.
transcribe.empty: The model returned no text for this file.
transcribe.unexpectedError: The file could not be transcribed.
transcribe.notAudio: That is not an audio file this app can read.

model.title: Model for files
model.description: Dictation needs a model that keeps up live. A recorded meeting does not, so it can use a slower, more accurate one. Switching models here means the next dictation reloads its own.
model.followDictationHint: Uses whatever model dictation is set to.

transcribe.cancellingHint: Finishing the current piece, then handing back everything transcribed so far.
transcribe.partialNote: This run stopped before the end of the recording. What you see is everything that was transcribed up to that point — the rest of the audio is not in it.
